================================================================================
Keyword where the word token is not valid
================================================================================
:#a
---
(program (holder (keyword)))

================================================================================
Retained keyword keeps its precedence over a longer literal
:error
================================================================================
:#a-
---
(program (holder (keyword)) (ERROR (UNEXPECTED '-')))

================================================================================
Optional keyword omitted where the word token is not valid
================================================================================
:#
---
(program (holder))

================================================================================
Keyword where the word token is valid
================================================================================
!#a b
---
(program (holder (keyword)) (word))

================================================================================
Keyword precedence beats the longer literal where the word token is valid
:error
================================================================================
!#a- b
---
(program (holder (keyword)) (ERROR (UNEXPECTED '-')) (word))

================================================================================
Optional keyword omitted where the word token is valid
================================================================================
!# b
---
(program (holder) (word))
